versions.subject: feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Product|contains: 'AutoHotkey'
    - Description|contains: 'AutoHotkey'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'AutoHotkey.exe'
        - 'AutoHotkey.rc'
filter:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\AutoHotkey.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkey32.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkey32_UIA.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkey64.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkey64_UIA.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyA32.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyA32_UIA.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyU32.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyU32_UIA.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyU64.exe'
        - '\AutoHotkeyU64_UIA.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Product="*AutoHotkey*" OR Description="*AutoHotkey*" OR OriginalFileName IN ("AutoHotkey.exe", "AutoHotkey.rc") NOT (Image IN ("*\\AutoHotkey.exe", "*\\AutoHotkey32.exe", "*\\AutoHotkey32_UIA.exe", "*\\AutoHotkey64.exe", "*\\AutoHotkey64_UIA.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyA32.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyA32_UIA.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyU32.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyU32_UIA.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyU64.exe", "*\\AutoHotkeyU64_UIA.exe"))
